Example failure scenario: If user leaves all 100 records unfiltered, getter would still extract 15 E201 lines and return success
Getter should verify that ALL lines in the saved document are E201 records (total line count == 15), not filter the file itself
Current logic defeats the purpose of verification - it does the filtering work instead of checking if user did it
The evaluator cannot distinguish between a correctly filtered file and an unfiltered file, making verification meaningless
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Modify getter to read ALL paragraphs without filtering, then verify ALL contain E201
Alternative: Read all paragraphs, count total lines, verify count == 15, then verify each line contains E201
Remove the filtering logic (lines 38-42 in getter) and instead return all non-empty lines
Add validation in metric or getter that ALL returned lines contain E201 in the correct position
Current flow: Read file → Filter to E201 → Count. Should be: Read file → Get all lines → Verify all are E201 → Count total
